name: Priyalakshmi Gogoi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Priyalakshmi Gogoi is a Guwahati poet and teacher whose writing has appeared in newspapers and literary journals. The Assam Tribune published her poem “Soul Dance” in 2021, while Literary Vibes has featured her work and described her practice in the short forms Saino and Gogyohka. Her writing life began during her school years, a detail shared by her journal biographies.

Her poems here approach change with a language of reassurance. “Let go” uses the weight of emotional baggage to ask what can be released; “TIME AND US” follows the passing years through joy, bereavement and faith. River, mirror and guiding light become familiar images through which the speakers seek patience and a way forward.
